finding: The conference Delta_L2 = 5.81% is an UPPER BOUND on incremental proposal exclusion, not a measurement of it. Measured I_CF spans 0.00% to 5.8128% across the four constant controls, and the frozen varying advisor B2 gives 2.4849%.
evidence: 06_summary_by_state_and_proposal.csv ICF rows; composition identity verified exact
impact: An advisor proposing Go or Delay in every CAUTION case is NEVER incrementally restricted, despite the gate reporting 5.81% set divergence. The endpoints are conditions on CAUTION CASES ALONE: I_CF = P(CAUTION) iff the advisor proposes DepartureTime or Duration in EVERY CAUTION case, and I_CF = 0 iff it proposes Go or Delay in every CAUTION case. Behaviour in SAFE and UNSAFE cases is irrelevant, since no SAFE case can be incrementally excluded and every UNSAFE case is already excluded by C1. The ceiling is therefore attainable WITHOUT a constant advisor. [corrected A18.2-R r2, E-3]
action: Report Delta_L2 as a ceiling. Actual incremental binding depends entirely on the proposal distribution, which the conference experiment never measured.
